section.title: Win32Native Class Reference
Detailed Description
section.para: This class provides native Windows operations using PHP COM extension. Replaces VBScript operations with direct COM/WMI access from PHP. Uses Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) and WScript.Shell COM objects.
